title.narrative: Training of relevant authorities in biopreparedness
The programme managed to raise awareness around biosecurity and safety at several universities.

actual.value: Awareness raising among close to 450 students. researchers and lecturers at leading life-science universities

title.narrative: Support for the legislative process in the area.
Meetings with Cabinet Secretaries, Principal Secretaries, Senior officials in the Ministry of Education and Ministry of Health (2017-2018).

target.value: High level meeting with Kenyan biosecurity stakeholders (2018).

actual.value: Draft biosecurity legislation with considerable Danish footprints (2019). Political mobilisation for support of the bill was ongoing at the end of the engagement but did not materialize into legislation in force.

title.narrative: The establishment of a biosecurity centre in Kenya

CBB endeavoured to build the capacity of a biosecurity agency pending the adoption of biosecurity bill. However, with the bill awaiting enactment, it was not possible to establish the centre without the legal backing of the bill. Engagements with National Commission For Science, Technology & Innovation (NACOSTI) over optimal biosecurity setup were not final by the end of the engagement.

title.narrative: Kenya helps bring biosecurity and biopreparedness on the regional agenda

Joint CBB, NACOSTI and Kenya’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs side-event at the BWC Meetings of Experts at the United Nations Office in Geneva (2018), CBB and NACOSTI presentations at BWC workshop in Addis Ababa (2018), CBB presentation at a BWC workshop in Pretoria (2018), CBB participation in Global Biosecurity Dialogue in Addis Ababa (2019). Critical to continuously take stock of risks and maintain high-level dialogue when expected progress does not materialise (in this case the lack of progress on the biosafety bill).

target.value: Biosafety preparedness gains traction at the regional agenda

actual.value: Joint CBB. NACOSTI and Kenya’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs side-event at the BWC Meetings of Experts at the United Nations Office in Geneva (2018). CBB and NACOSTI presentations at BWC workshop in Addis Ababa (2018). CBB presentation at a BWC workshop in Pretoria (2018). CBB participation in Global Biosecurity Dialogue in Addis Ababa (2019).

title.narrative: Strengthened knowledge of biosecurity and biopreparedness nationally

CBB was unable to find a partner with a clear mandate and resources to receive biopreparedness capacity building and be a channel for information dissemination at an adequate level.Preparation of a book about the Danish biopreparedness model shared with Kenyan stakeholders in 2019.

target.value: Increased knowledge on Biosafety preparedness in Kenya

actual.value: Preparation of a book about the Danish biopreparedness model shared with Kenyan stakeholders in 2019.
